name: boss
description: Imposing boss enemy for a 2D side-scrolling action game. Large, deliberate movements.
style_notes: Side-view 2D pixel art boss sprite. Large imposing silhouette. High-contrast limited palette. Thick 2-3 px dark outline for readability at scale. Detailed enough to read at 128×128 but not overworked. No soft gradients, no painterly rendering, no UI, no text, no scenery.

animations.name: idle
animations.action: Imposing idle stance with slow threatening sway. Subtle weight shift. Weapon or limbs move slightly. Menacing but patient energy.

animations.name: walk
animations.action: Slow deliberate advance toward the player. Heavy footfalls implied by pose. Left-facing.

animations.name: tell
animations.action: Visual telegraph before a big attack. Dramatic windup or raised weapon. Readable warning pose. Gives the player a cue.

animations.name: heavy_attack
animations.action: Slow powerful slash with long windup, full commitment swing, and long recovery. Wide sweep, clearly telegraphed. Frames: windup start, windup peak, swing begin, swing apex, follow-through, slow recovery 1, slow recovery 2, end.

animations.name: special_attack
animations.action: Boss's signature move — dramatic multi-hit or area attack. Make it visually distinct from heavy_attack.
animations.prompt_notes: This is the boss's most iconic move. Make the silhouette clearly different from heavy_attack.

animations.name: stagger
animations.action: Posture-break stagger: the boss reels backward, brief vulnerability window with shaky recovery pose. Clearly a weakness state.

animations.name: hurt
animations.action: Minor hit reaction: brief flinch, body absorbs the blow, quick recovery. Less dramatic than stagger.

animations.name: death
animations.action: Dramatic death sequence: stagger on hit, slow collapse, fall, final prone pose. Should feel weighty and conclusive.
